plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the seventeenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XY DVD sets were released between 2015 and 2016 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Set 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY - Set 1 was released on August 4, 2015. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined.

 

===Set 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY - Set 2 was released on January 19, 2016. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokemon The Series: XY Complete Season was released by with distribution through on June 11, 2024 at a MSRP of $59.99 USD. The Complete Collection contains 6 DVD discs with 48 episodes combined in a . Its catalog number is 3000097427.
